summary: Your installation stays tidy, and the web app's components carry Microsoft's November security updates.

new.title: Older program images are cleaned up
new.text: After a healthy update, SecurityInsight keeps only the current release's images and the one before. Nothing is deleted when the update did not end healthy.

fixes.title: Web app components on November security updates
fixes.text: The web app's own components carry Microsoft's November security updates.

fixes.title: Security pack names the support scripts
fixes.text: The security pack names the published support scripts, with their rights and changes.
